components.title: Agent Skill Library
components.purpose: Delivers reusable agent capabilities as self-contained skill directories, each carrying a SKILL.md manifest with YAML frontmatter plus optional reference documents, executable scripts, and templates that the agent loads on demand.

primary.rationale: Every top-level skill definition and its bundled references live here; this directory is the component.

shared.rationale: Authoring scaffolds for new skills, also used when a command needs to emit a skill-shaped artifact.

components.title: Slash Command Surface
components.purpose: Delivers namespaced slash commands as flat markdown files under commands/<namespace>/, where the team namespace additionally carries the four-layer orchestration router that selects roles and sequences agent handoffs.

primary.rationale: All command definitions plus the /team router, its role registry, and its protocol files live here.

components.title: Bundled Orchestration Systems
components.purpose: Delivers multi-phase project orchestration, knowledge tracking, and persona-council capabilities as optional bundles, each shipping its own nested skills and agents that install independently of the core asset set.

primary.rationale: The GSD, brain, superintelligence, and team bundles, each self-contained with its own nested skills directory.

components.title: Subagent Role Definitions
components.purpose: Delivers the named subagent roles that commands dispatch work to, together with the behavioural rules those agents load, so that a role's system prompt is defined once and reused across every pipeline that spawns it.

primary.rationale: Agent role definitions and the behavioural rule set they carry; both are dispatched by the command surface rather than invoked directly.

components.title: Multi-Editor Install Adapters
components.purpose: Delivers installation across Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex by symlinking skills, commands, and agents into each tool's configuration directory under a per-editor namespace mapping, with a Homebrew formula for bootstrap.

primary.rationale: The namespace mapping, symlink logic, bootstrap script, and package formula that make the asset set installable.

notes: Structural index only. Component altitude is C4-Container; these paths are not work-assignment boundaries. Build tooling (scripts/), generated catalogs (docs/), CI workflows, tests, examples, and static assets are deliberately excluded under the runtime-only rule in references/component-rules.md, so they appear in no component.
